answer: Keep every identity on one unbroken thread of signed work receipts, each entry chained to the last. At random, a challenger names an old entry and the agent must mirror it back extended: recompute its result live and build the next step from it. A sybil operator can fake a fresh alias, but cannot fake a long distinct past per alias: the delta between real histories grows with every receipt, so running hundreds of aliases means storing and re-performing hundreds of diverging pasts, a cost that scales with the farm itself.
